notes.title: 1.0.7 - Steam Overlay Update
notes.content:
I've just published an update which enables the Steam overlay!
Pressing your default key combination (usually SHIFT + TAB) will bring up the Steam overlay.
I have tested it a little and it seems to work smoothly. 
Please let me know if you have any problems with it.

I have also made some changes to the puzzle selection in the Humans category, for a more coherent art style.

notes.title: 1.0.2 - Bug Fix Update
notes.content:
I've published an update which fixes a small bug involving the puzzle piece movement.
Now, puzzle pieces will recenter to the cursor when picked up.

Let me know about more fixes/improvements I can make, your feedback is very useful!
